description: What a company has paid its shareholders, year by year from its annual XBRL: dividends per share (split-adjusted record: years raised in a row, 5- and 10-year growth) and in total, buybacks and shares issued for cash, the diluted share count and its change, the payout ratio and the share of free cash flow paid out, and at the last close the dividend yield and shareholder yield.

price.description: Add the dividend and shareholder yields at the last close; default true.

years.description: Fiscal years to show, newest first; default 10.

name: shareholder_returns

outputSchema.description: rows are fiscal years, newest first, in the order of columns; dividends is the split-adjusted record; yields use the last close.

title: Dividends and buybacks
